target.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: The Web UI sidebar Recent Sessions list could hide existing child-spawned subagent transcripts when the current chat scope was another agent, so users could not intentionally rediscover those sessions from the left sidebar.
- Solution: Keep the default scoped sidebar behavior, but add an explicit sidebar **All agents** mode for sidebar-owned Recent Sessions refresh/search/display only.
- What changed: Migrated the original fix onto the current Control UI architecture (`AppSidebar`, `SessionPicker`, `SessionCapability`, `SessionsPage`, and session navigation helpers). Sidebar-owned all-agents requests omit `agentId` and include child/spawned subagent rows; default scoped mode still filters by the active chat agent and hides child/spawned subagent rows. Checkpoint opener, checkpoint branch/restore, and chat-send refreshes remain scoped to their target session/agent.
- What did NOT change / out of scope: This does not change gateway protocol/schema, stored transcript format, migration behavior, public config, the default scoped sidebar view, or make **All agents** a global Sessions-tab mode.
- Why it matters / User impact: Users with persisted child-spawned subagent work can intentionally find and reopen those existing transcripts from the sidebar without losing the safer default scoped view, and non-sidebar refreshes do not accidentally broaden to all agents.
- Fixes #95295

## What Problem This Solves

The sidebar needed an intentional way to rediscover persisted child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes. The conflict resolution also had to preserve the follow-up boundary repairs from the existing PR: sidebar **All agents** must stay local to the sidebar, while checkpoint entry, checkpoint mutation, and chat-send refreshes must keep using the current/checkpoint/target session's agent scope.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** Recent Sessions had a request/filter invariant mismatch: the sidebar requested the current agent's session list and then filtered out child/subagent-spawned rows, which made persisted child-spawned sessions from another agent scope undiscoverable from the sidebar.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** The fix makes the request/filter invariant explicit. Default sidebar mode still requests and filters scoped rows. The new sidebar-owned **All agents** mode intentionally requests without `agentId` and opts the sidebar visibility helper into child/spawned rows. Non-sidebar refreshes derive scope from the current/checkpoint/target session key instead of reading sidebar state, so the all-agents opt-in cannot leak into checkpoint, Sessions-page, or chat-send refreshes.
- **Fix classification:** Root-cause UI/session-state fix with bounded conflict-resolution migration to the current Control UI architecture.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High for the scoped code/test repair after the rebase conflict migration; maintainer product selection remains required because sibling candidate PRs (#95304 and #95307) exist with different scopes.
- **Patch quality notes:** The two `as unknown as ...` casts are confined to Vitest mocks that adapt a minimal fake client/host to existing test-only interfaces; production code does not add type escapes. The `return undefined` branch in `SessionsPage.sessionListAgentId` is a no-context guard for a helper that cannot compute scope without application context; callers already treat missing `agentId` as an unscoped list option. The diff is slightly over the file-count preference because the old `ui/src/ui/...` implementation was deleted on main and the same behavior had to be migrated into the new component/capability/page layout rather than restoring deleted files.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** The source of truth remains the existing `sessions.list` request contract and session keys (`agent:<agentId>:...`). Sidebar Recent Sessions owns the **All agents** opt-in request/filter behavior; checkpoint and chat flows own their target-session scope. No protocol, schema, storage, migration, transcript format, gateway contract, or public config is changed.

## Implementation Notes

- `ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.ts` now accepts a sidebar all-agents flag. Default navigation stays scoped and hides child/spawned subagent rows; all-agents mode disables agent filtering for the sidebar list and includes child/spawned rows while preserving archived/global/unknown/cron exclusions.
- `ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts` owns the **All agents** toggle and uses it only for sidebar Recent Sessions refresh/navigation/picker state.
- `ui/src/components/session-picker.ts` omits `agentId` only when the explicit all-agents picker mode is active; default picker rows remain filtered to the current agent.
- `ui/src/lib/sessions/index.ts` derives checkpoint branch/restore refresh scope from the checkpoint session key or explicit agent override, so checkpoint mutations do not inherit a shared all-agents list state.
- `ui/src/pages/sessions/sessions-page.ts` scopes checkpoint-opener list loads to the checkpoint session's agent.
- `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`, `ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts`, and `ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts` lock in the scoped/non-scoped boundaries.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Default sidebar Recent Sessions remains scoped to the active chat agent and excludes child/spawned subagent sessions. Pressing **All agents** on the sidebar intentionally allows cross-agent child/spawned subagent sessions to appear there. Checkpoint opener, checkpoint branch/restore, and chat-send `sessions.list` refreshes remain scoped to the current/checkpoint/target session's agent and do not inherit the sidebar all-agents toggle.
- **Real environment tested:** Local OpenClaw PR worktree on Windows/Git Bash, with pnpm workspace dependencies installed. The environment has Node `v22.17.0` and pnpm `11.2.2`; pnpm emitted the repo's non-fatal engine warning requesting Node `>=22.19.0 <23 || >=23.11.0`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:** `git diff --check`; `pnpm check:no-conflict-markers`; `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 ui/src/components/app-sidebar.ts ui/src/components/session-picker.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/index.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts ui/src/pages/sessions/sessions-page.ts ui/src/styles/layout.css`; `pnpm --dir ui test src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`; `pnpm check:test-types`; `pnpm lint`.
- **Evidence after fix:** `git diff --check` and `pnpm check:no-conflict-markers` exited 0. The scoped formatter check exited 0 for all 9 changed files. The focused UI/session regression command exited 0 with 3 test files and 104 tests passing. `pnpm check:test-types` exited 0. `pnpm lint` exited 0.
- **Observed result after fix:** The navigation tests assert default scoped rows stay on the active agent and hide child/spawned subagent rows, while explicit sidebar all-agents mode includes a cross-agent spawned/subagent row and still filters cron rows. The session capability test asserts checkpoint branch/restore for `agent:review:*` refresh `sessions.list` with `agentId: "review"`. The chat send test asserts post-send refresh for `agent:ops:*` uses `agentId: "ops"`.
- **What was not tested:** I could not run a long-lived live gateway/Mantis/private transcript proof in this contributor environment, so this PR does not claim real Mantis or private live-gateway coverage. `pnpm check:changed` could not run because local `crabbox` failed its basic sanity check before delegating to Blacksmith Testbox. Full `pnpm --dir ui test` was attempted but is not usable as local proof here because unrelated baseline tests failed under the Chinese system locale and Vitest browser tests could not launch without an installed Playwright Chromium binary; the focused changed-file UI/session regressions above passed.

## Review findings addressed

- Current refreshed review checklist has no actionable line-review findings.
- The previous old-architecture `ui/src/ui/...` implementation conflicts were not restored. Their behavior was migrated into the current Control UI architecture files listed above.
- PR #95320 still has sibling candidate PR references (#95304 and #95307) in the linked issue context. This PR intentionally stays on the narrow same-contract UI path; final product/canonical selection remains a maintainer decision.

## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test file:** `ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts`, `ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts`, and `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`.
- **Target test files:** `ui/src/lib/sessions/navigation.test.ts`, `ui/src/lib/sessions/index.test.ts`, and `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`.
- **Scenario locked in:** Explicit sidebar all-agents mode is the only path that both omits sidebar request `agentId` and includes child/spawned subagent rows. Default sidebar mode remains scoped to the active chat agent. Checkpoint opener and checkpoint branch/restore refreshes stay scoped to the checkpoint/current session agent. Post-send refreshes stay scoped to the target chat session agent.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** The navigation tests guard the sidebar request/filter boundary, the session capability test guards checkpoint mutation refresh scope, and the chat-send test guards shared post-send refresh scope. Together they prevent the sidebar toggle from becoming a global session-list mode without requiring gateway/protocol/storage changes.

## Merge risk

- **Risk labels considered:** session-state / security-boundary / compatibility / UI visibility.
- **Risk explanation:** The diff touches session-state UI filtering and a scope control, which can affect whether existing child-spawned transcripts are visible in the sidebar. Compatibility risk is limited because explicit/default scoped refreshes remain authoritative outside the sidebar and no public protocol, schema, config, storage format, transcript format, or migration contract changes.
- **Why acceptable:** The new cross-agent visibility is default-off, explicitly user-selected, and limited to the sidebar Recent Sessions list. Existing archived/global/unknown/cron exclusions remain. Checkpoint and chat refreshes stay scoped, so enabling **All agents** does not widen non-sidebar refreshes.
